content:
Following the preview at I/O 2026 this past May, Gemini for macOS is now rolling out advanced voice control capabilities.

Google is positioning the feature as letting you "speak naturally across any window on your desktop," with two main capabilities.

The first is Smart Voice Input, which transcribes what you say "into clean, polished text." Gemini will automatically remove filler words like "um" and "uh," while also accounting for mid-sentence corrections to accurately capture what you're trying to say.

The formatted text will be inserted at your current cursor location. This will offer a voice-to-text experience similar to the upcoming Gboard Rambler on Gemini Intelligence phones.

The other capability goes beyond simple transcription to understand what's on your current screen for complex tasks. This opt-in capability requires you to turn on Gemini reasoning in the app's settings.

  • Capture and synthesize info: Highlight local files, images, or documents on your desktop and tell Gemini your specific need. For example, you could say, "Read through these vet records and email the pet boarding facility a summary of my dog's medical history."
  • Write and rewrite text: Highlight text anywhere on your screen, then use your voice to rewrite, adjust the tone, and have the polished version inserted directly where you need it. Try saying something like, "Rewrite these notes into an executive summary, and add a TL;DR at the beginning."
  • Generate and edit images: Use your voice to create images — whether you're brainstorming concepts, fleshing out a travel itinerary, or iterating on a design from your desktop to ask for quick modifications. Try saying something like, "Generate a dark mode version of this illustration."

Launch it anywhere on macOS with a long press of the Fn key, or by clicking the new screen share button at the end of the "Ask Gemini" prompt box. Gemini will display a floating capsule with a sound wave pattern at the bottom of your screen.

Make sure you've updated the macOS version of Gemini to the latest version (1.88). The new voice capabilities are rolling out globally and currently support English, with more languages "coming later."
